notes.title: Patch 1.3 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It is now a few month past the release and thank you so much for all your feedbacks ! We took them all in and have worked hard making another patch which addresses some of the feedback we have received! So Patch 1.3 is here - featuring some long-requested features! This includes: 

[list]
[*] Shoulder camera option. ( At the start of a new game you will have to decide which camera style sits better with you )
[*] Improved graphics ( Overal improvement of look and lighting )
[*] Shoulder combat system ( Well this had to be done in order to make the shoulder camera style fits )
[*] Sprint mechanic ( Let's go fast from point A to point B )
[*] Steam Deck Support ( Aiming to go from playable to verified )
[*] Cloud Save Support 
[*] And much more! 
[/list]

We'll have a new trailer coming soon! Check out some of these new screenshots showing off the improved graphics! In the meantime, be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ElsewareE]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Покинутый городок Сен-Эгзиль и одинокая девушка с часами-крабом: Обзор Broken Pieces
notes.notes: 9 сентября 2022 года в продажу поступил Broken Pieces. Психологический триллер, действие которого разворачивается в прибрежном городке, был выпущен командой из пяти человек. Французская студия Elseware Experience открылась в 2008 году и до этого занималась созданием модификаций на Source и архитектурной визуализацией. Затем она решила попробовать силы в разработке полноценного проекта. Что из этого вышло, читайте ниже.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We appreciate all the feedback yall have been sending to us. We've been listening to that feedback and have another patch for you all. Please keep the feedback coming. If you find any bugs or anything, please report them in our [url=https://discord.gg/ZC8zNsjWUc]Discord [/url]through our ticketing system. 

[list]
[*] added a progression board when you go to sleep with new documents.
[*] added ending tape played during credits to add more context to the ending.
[*] updated ps5 icons
[*] added asset to indicate miss boismet house door (atop of it)
[*] added post it to first electrical box to help players look up
[*] fixed dreamlike entrance from church that should now properly disappear when the level is completed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
Thank you for your support throughout our first week of launch! We've fixed a number of things that you all have been experiencing. If you are still experiencing issues, please report it in our [url=https://discord.gg/ZC8zNsjWUc]Discord [/url]through our ticketing system. 

[list]
[*] Saving issue is now fixed. Please see the special forum thread made for this very issue if the update didn't fix your corrupted saves. If you had no issue before, you won't have any after ;)
[*] You can now change game's difficulty inside the game setting at any time.
[*] Changed max consumable you can carry from 6 to 8.
[*] Changed max ammoHQ you can carry from 10 to 24.
[*] Fixed achievements not being unlock in patch 1.0.1. The game will check automaticaly your progress
[*] and update you achievements accordingly except for the crow achievement.
[*] If you want the "game finished" achievement you will have to redo the last action of the game. (trying not to spoil)
[*] French cassette "L'assomptiom" should now have audio.
[*] Fixed [spoiler]extended magazine[/spoiler] not applying the boost.
[*] Main menu should now display the correct input types.
[*] Tentative fix for reusable interactions that were very rarely blocking player's movements.
[*] Added 2 more informative subobjectives to add more indicative substeps to the longest quest of the game.
[*] Fix for rare occurences where Elise would get stuck when trying to walk on a fallen tree.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to our dear player that face bug during these first few days of release and reported them to us over here on steam or via discord.
We are working on different patchs for the game but this first one contains fix for :

- Added security to the "Boisseau's park" key that can be dropped in the air under rare occurences. If you save and then reload the game the key will be back on the floor.

- Tentative fix for rare saving issues that could happen with asynchronous saving at very precise point in the game.

- Ending credit now successfully stop the music when triggered from the main menu.

- LIghthouse combat wall near the lighthouse fix.

- The museum (and not musuem) now only complete its mission when the electricity is back on.


We have a list of known bugs that we are working on fixing. To name a few :

- Adding a new board that Elise will update to keep a clear overview on your progression and the answers she finds.

- Clarifying two subojectives during the plate picking phase.

- Ammunition issues in relation with the chest.

- More investigations on the saving problem if still existing.

- Walking on the fallen tree inside the first dreamlike scene can sometime freeze the game. 

- Other smaller fixes.


Thanks a lot for playing the game and supporting it. We'v seen great videos around here of you playing and it really keeps us going.

All the best,
Mael

notes.title: Broken Pieces Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We’re thrilled to announce that Broken Pieces is now being published by Freedom Games 
( [url=https://freedom.gg]https://freedom.gg[/url] ). For those of you who may not know, a game publisher not only provides additional investment and funding for developing the game, but also takes care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. It really lets us totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be, and provides us with the resources to do so. 

Thank you for all of the support you've given us. If you have any questions about the announcement, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZC8zNsjWUc]Discord[/url] and we’d love to hear from you!
Also make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ElsewareE]Twitter[/url].
